payload.text: 0072's chain needs hv's words in gtools-ic's session, in order: (1) hv's look at arca_swift's example console (AC-09.6) after a green run E; (2) the landing on arca_swift's main; (3) the push to GitHub, whose push run on main is 0.2.0's dependency proof on Xcode 26.6; (4) the 0.2.0 tag. gtools-vc put them to hv on 20 Oct, and gtools-ic sends utilz-ic and vc the tag's sha and run id. Then utilz-ic adopts it in menuz as 0072 (design approved, with point 11; menuz 0.4.6), booked red, green and a dev install for hv's eye, then a Utilz dispatch. It ships in 2.14.2 with 0095 (vc's decision 49), and the cut waits for it.
